mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 55 degrees out at Fireman's Park under a Waxing Gibbous moon. Tonight, the low will hit 51 degrees with no rain predicted.
The city is preparing for fall with leaf collection beginning October 5, and the Plan Commission is meeting the same day to review several development projects including a new site plan for Sub-Zero.
Today you can catch live music at Paddy Mac's or trivia at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, don't miss the Fall Fest on September 25 at Hometown USA Festival Park.
On September 3, a 33-year-old man was arrested for an O W I offence after crashing his vehicle on Shooting Star Road.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently closed for the night. They will reopen tomorrow at 10 AM to serve up tomorrow's flavor of the day.
